exposure: initial breastfeeding after the first hour
cohort: 15,322 infants aged < 6 months and 3,243 infants aged 12-15 months seeking care from public sector health care providers
finding: While exclusive breastfeeding at 6 months and continued breastfeeding showed some improvement, the rate of breastfed infants is still below desirable levels.
mod_finding: Delivery via C-section was independently associated with a lower frequency of exclusive breastfeeding (< 6 months old) and breastfeeding.
